scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run quality && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.contracts:check: forge fmt --check && forge lint && forge test && node scripts/generate-contract-artifacts.mjs --check
scripts.deploy:dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env testnet --config wrangler.api.jsonc --secrets-file .api.secrets.example && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env testnet --config wrangler.sweeper.jsonc --secrets-file .sweeper.secrets.example && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env mainnet --config wrangler.api.jsonc --secrets-file .api.secrets.example && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env mainnet --config wrangler.sweeper.jsonc --secrets-file .sweeper.secrets.example && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env testnet --config wrangler.demo.jsonc --secrets-file .demo.secrets.example

PAYMENT_API_KEY.description: Random server-to-server API key with at least 24 characters.

NETWORKS_JSON.description: JSON array of enabled EVM networks; see .dev.vars.example.

PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Absolute HTTPS URL that receives payment events.

PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random HMAC signing key with at least 24 characters.
